newsitem.title: EGYPT: Mubarak, Peres start talks in Egyptian resort.
newsitem.headline: Mubarak, Peres start talks in Egyptian resort.

text.p: Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak and former Israeli prime minister Shimon Peres started talks on the Middle East peace process in the Sinai resort of Sharm el-Sheikh on Sunday.
Peres, head of the opposition Labour party, was expected to spend only a few hours in the Egyptian town.

He last visited Sharm el-Sheikh in March when Egypt and the United States co-sponsored an international summit there in support of the peace process after a string of suicide bombings by Moslem militants killed dozens of people in Israel.
Peres lost his position as premier to right-winger Benjamin Netanayhu in elections in May.

Egypt, which in 1979 became the first Arab state to sign a peace treaty with Israel, has urged Netanyahu to fulfil the peace pledges the Labour party government had signed with the Palestine Liberation Organisation.
